prompt:
Use case: compositing / website hero design. Create ONE FINISHED, WIDE SHIFT HEALTH TESTING HERO DESIGN, approximately 2.2:1, with all information and polished typography included, based on the quality and composition of the attached sleep hero design examples. This is a complete designed hero for review, not a plain photograph and not a grid. Input 1 is a layout and quality reference only. Inputs 2 and 3 are the REAL product photographs: the red cholesterol self-test with its supplied components, and the yellow Diabetes Lab test box. Preserve the actual products and their lettering faithfully; do not redesign the packs, add supplier names, invent components or change their stated claims.

NEW SCENE, completely different from a man reading a leaflet in a kitchen: on the RIGHT, an ordinary, visibly overweight bald British man of about 50 with a short full salt-and-pepper beard stands relaxed at open conservatory doors looking into his sunny garden, holding a stoneware mug. He has a clearly substantial belly and thick waist, and wears an unbranded muted olive polo and dark jeans. Comfortable, natural, subtly upbeat and well presented; believable human skin and age, no slim athletic model or fashion catalogue pose. Beautiful soft morning light, leafy garden, modest British home, gentle depth of field, mid-thigh-up framing. No leaflet, no letter-reading, no kitchen-table scene, no distress, no white coat or medical procedure.

Professional art direction: left 47% is a rich near-black (#050505) softly textured area blending naturally into the warm conservatory/garden photograph on the right. Cream (#E7E3DA) typography, ash green (#707762) button, cream/olive accents. Avoid turquoise, navy branding, white interface panels and arbitrary bright accents. Show the genuine cholesterol and diabetes products PROMINENTLY in the lower-right foreground on a tasteful cream surface, large enough to recognise the pack and testing components, with natural shadows and clean edges. They must feel integrated into the hero and must not cover the man's face. No enormous empty product box or tiny floating product.

Exact copy, correctly spelled and confidently typeset with clear hierarchy and generous but purposeful spacing:
Small brand line at top left: "SHIFT HEALTH"
Eyebrow: "TESTING & WELLBEING"
Large bold headline, left aligned: "Know a bit more.\nTake your next step."
Supporting copy: "Lab tests and at-home self-tests.\nClear information to help you choose, understand your test and know its limits."
A polished row of three crisp, simple line icons with their labels: flask "Lab tests"; home "At-home self-tests"; open guide "Clear product guides".
A large ash-green pill button with cream lettering: "Explore the tests"
Small cream text beneath the button: "Prices TBC · Currently out of stock"

Make the full headline, explanatory copy, icons and button visible and easily readable. Match the professional, integrated hero design quality of the reference, while using SHIFT's own black, cream and muted ash-green palette. No arrows or emojis, no invented prices, no review stars, no diagnostic guarantees, no claim of a doctor consultation. This must look like a finished premium website hero, with an everyday relatable man and real testing products, not a generic stock photograph.

approval.context: Matt approved the complete garden hero shown in this conversation.

rendering: Approved image retained without generative changes. The right-hand photographic composition is shown using CSS cropping; its approved copy and CTA are real, visible HTML. On mobile, the photograph is shown above the same copy. PNG to WebP compression only.
